title: mc-test results.json
description: Structured, typed run report written beside the JUnit XML (docs/CI.md; spec commandcenter/40-testing-loop.md §6). One object per `mc-test run` invocation: run-level totals + one entry per case. A 'case' is one (test x target) cell, or — for a test with a `matrix:` block — one (matrix case x target) cell whose `config` carries the bound dimension values.

declared.description: The DECLARED UNIVERSE: total cases the run's tests declare, summed over targets. For a `matrix:` test this is the full cross-product whatever coverage model ran — under `coverage: pairwise` it is larger than `executed`, so completeness (`executed/declared`, spec §7) never flatters a partial run.

executed.description: Cases that actually ran (passed + failed + errored). A skip is declared-but-not-executed and counts AGAINST completeness (spec §4).

coverage_model.description: How `declared` was computed. 'flat': one case per (test x target), no matrix dimensions (pre-matrix-engine). Later values: 'full' | 'pairwise' (spec §4).

target.description: Comma-joined target id(s) this run covered.

sha.description: Git commit of the project under test (cwd at invocation time), best-effort. Absent when cwd is not a git checkout or git is unavailable.

lints.description: Static findings about the run's tests (spec §5.3), computed at expansion time: 'vacuous-branch' (an expect:/except: entry whose when: selects no generated case) and 'dead-dimension' (a dimension no expectation depends on — its values are theater). Present only when something was found. Carried here, not just printed, so the coverage web can render them like skips instead of letting them inflate completeness.

config.description: The case's configuration. Pre-matrix-engine this is the target identity (target/loader/mc/driver); the matrix engine (spec §4) will add per-dimension bound values here.

failed_step.description: `<index>:<verb>` of the step that failed, when status is fail|error.

expected.description: What the `expect:` invariant demanded of THIS case, rendered with its config bound (spec §4-§5). Absent when the test declares no invariant.

actual.description: What the world actually reported for those expectations — or why they were never evaluated.

evidence.description: Artifact paths (screenshots, server logs) attached to this case, always present (possibly empty).

invariant_ref.description: The authored branch(es) that judged this case: '<test>#expect[i]', or '<test>#except[i].expect[j]' for a per-case override (spec §5).

exception.description: Present ONLY when a per-case `except:` override replaced the shared invariant for this case, carrying its authored justification. Spec §4: exceptions are allowed but visually flagged — they are where circular oracles sneak back in.
